interface.description: The wireless network interface to use (e.g., wlan0mon).

mode.description: The attack mode identifier: b (Beacon), a (Auth DoS), p (SSID Probe), d (Deauth), m (Michael), e (EAPOL), s (Mesh), w (WIDS), f (Packet Fuzzer), c (PoC Testing).

target_bssid.description: Target AP MAC address (used in modes p, m, e, c). For mode d, this sets -B (AP BSSID).

target_essid.description: Target or Fake SSID. Used as -E in mode d, or as a single SSID for mode b if not using a file.

speed_pps.description: Speed limit in packets per second (-s). Empty string uses default.

channel.description: Target channel for Beacon flooding (-c) or channel hopping configuration.

enable_channel_hopping.description: Enable channel hopping (-h) where supported by the mode.

hop_speed_ms.description: Channel hopping speed in milliseconds (-c chan:speed).

encryption_types.description: Encryption types for Beacon Flooding (-w). n=No Encrypt, w=WEP, t=TKIP, a=AES.

ssid_file.description: File containing SSIDs for Beacon Flooding (-f).

whitelist_file.description: File containing MACs to ignore in Deauth/Disassoc mode (-w).

blacklist_file.description: File containing MACs to target in Deauth/Disassoc mode (-b).

bitrate.description: Bitrate for Beacon Flooding (-b). b=11Mbit, g=54Mbit.

use_valid_ap_mac.description: Use valid AP MAC from OUI database in Beacon Flooding (-m).

use_valid_client_mac.description: Use valid client MAC from OUI database in Auth DoS mode (-m).

target_ssid_probe.description: Specific SSID to probe for in Mode p (-e).

bruteforce_charset.description: Character sets for SSID Brute-forcing in Mode p (-b). n=Numbers, u=Upper, l=Lower, s=Symbols.

wordlist_file.description: Wordlist file for SSID Brute-forcing in Mode p (-f).

start_word.description: Start word for SSID Brute-forcing in Mode p (-p).

mc_wait_seconds.description: Wait time in seconds between Michael Countermeasures bursts (-w).

mc_packets_per_burst.description: Number of random packets per Michael Countermeasures burst (-n).

mc_use_qos_exploit.description: Use QoS exploit for Michael Countermeasures (-j).

use_logoff_messages.description: Use EAPOL Logoff messages in Mode e (-l). If false, floods with Start frames.

mesh_id.description: Target Mesh Network ID in Mode s (-n).

fuzzer_sources.description: Packet sources for Packet Fuzzer mode (-s). a=Sniff, b=Beacon, c=CTS, p=Probe.

fuzzer_modifiers.description: Packet modifiers for Packet Fuzzer mode (-m). n=None, b=DstBcast, m=SrcBcast, s=Shotgun, t=RandBytes, c=CutShort, d=RandDuraFlags.

custom_hex_ie.description: User-defined IEs in hexadecimal appended to frames (-i).

poc_vendor_test.description: Vendor test file name for PoC Testing (-v).

poc_station_mac.description: Station MAC address for PoC Testing (-S).
